name: ihistand
description: Claude Code plugins for data engineering, business intelligence, and 3D printing workflows

plugins.name: dataform-toolkit
plugins.description: Comprehensive toolkit for BigQuery Dataform development with engineering best practices, TDD workflow, and ETL agent integration

plugins.name: sqlanvil-toolkit
plugins.description: Engineering best practices for sqlanvil data projects on PostgreSQL and Supabase: corrects Dataform/BigQuery priors, plus named connections (cross-warehouse sources) and the introspect workflow. Includes /sqlanvil-compile, -test, -run, -new-table, -introspect commands

plugins.name: acuantia-dataform
plugins.description: Acuantia-specific patterns for BigQuery Dataform development. Extends dataform-engineering-fundamentals with ODS two-arg ref() syntax, looker_ filename conventions, and integration with callrail/dialpad/looker projects.

plugins.name: stl-generator-toolkit
plugins.description: Comprehensive toolkit for generating 3D printable STL files for woodworking jigs and fixtures using CadQuery, with pre-built scripts and parametric design patterns
